title: S2-B4 protocol prospective identifiability supplement
decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B4_PROTOCOL_V1_SUPPLEMENT_1. For the six market-state interaction hypotheses replace the non-identifiable within-date four-column regression implementation with a two-stage date-level estimator: Stage 1, for each eligible date t and horizon h estimate cross-sectionally forward_return_i,t,h = a_t,h + b_t,h * primary_rank_i,t + error; Stage 2 estimate across dates b_t,h = alpha_h + gamma_h * Z_t + u_t,h. gamma_h is the primary market-conditioning estimand. Standardize each market state prospectively as Z_t=(X_t-mean(X_<t))/sd(X_<t), strictly excluding t, requiring at least 20 prior eligible finite observations, sample SD ddof=1, and treating missing/nonfinite mean or SD or SD<=1e-12 as ineligible. Preserve the six market hypotheses, four liquidity hypotheses, six horizons, 60-test BH family, q=0.05, and all other frozen B4 gates/dispositions. HAC for Stage 2 remains Newey-West Bartlett lag=horizon-1, two-sided 95%. Standardized market-interaction effect is gamma_h/sample_sd(b_t,h), ddof=1. Four chronological blocks recompute the complete two-stage estimator within each frozen block. Symbol concentration and leave-top-five diagnostics remove specified symbols from Stage 1 and recompute the complete Stage1-to-Stage2 estimator. No outcome-driven choices are authorized.
evidence: Prospective clarification approved by canonical Indicator: Swing Trades thread before any B4 real outcome computation. Work preparation reported no B4 outcomes, effect sizes, p-values, profitability or protected holdout access before this supplement.
rationale: The frozen within-date design is rank deficient because market_state is constant across symbols on a trading date: market_state is collinear with the intercept and primary_rank*market_state is collinear with primary_rank. The approved two-stage estimator identifies whether the date-level cross-sectional factor slope changes with the market state while retaining trading date as the inference unit and preserving the preregistered scientific family.

robustness_mapping.leave_top5: same full recomputation; sign reversal blocks support
robustness_mapping.temporal_blocks: recompute complete two-stage estimator within each frozen block
robustness_mapping.symbol_concentration: remove specified symbols from Stage 1 then recompute complete Stage1-to-Stage2 estimator

two_stage_estimator.stage1: per-date cross-sectional OLS: forward_return ~ intercept + primary_rank
